description: This file defines the UserController class in an ASP.NET Core application, providing endpoints for retrieving and updating user information via HTTP GET and PUT methods.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core controller handling user-related HTTP requests, using dependency injection of IMediator and ICurrentUserAccessor to get user data and process commands.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve current user information, sends a Details.Query via MediatR.

methods.name: UpdateUser
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update user data, accepting a command object and dispatching it via MediatR.
